blocks.text: Break through, layer by layer
Every hit burns through shields, then armor, then hull, and each weapon is better against a different one.
A Shipyard builds warships as specialists that each hunt one kind of target.
Drones, tractor beams, missile salvos, flak, rail guns: each class can fight its own way.
Living star systems
Radiation zones, spice nebulae, ion storms and twin suns shape every battlefield.
Worlds worth fighting for
Grow your pops, dig your worlds' crusts dry, and watch a drained gas giant blow.
An opponent that never cheats
Scripted or neural, the AI plays your rules and sees only what its sensors see.
The loop
Mine, haul, build, attack, take worlds. Your worlds feed and power it all.
Research what your strategy needs, and strike before the enemy outgrows you.
What you can see
Ships inside a spice nebula stay hidden unless an enemy is close; a seen enemy starbase stays on your map.
Resources
A finite galaxy
Nothing refills. Rocks, gas giants, worlds' crusts and spice nebulae all run out, so a long match becomes a fight over what is left.
Winning and losing
Destroy every enemy starbase and Constructor, or starve them into a Terminal Blackout. Losing every world does not end the game.
